items.text: Daniel Lee is a business owner who lives in Hoffman Estates. He serves on the Economic Development Commission and Planning and Zoning Commission for the Village of Hoffman Estates. His campaign says he is a 30-year resident of Cook County who supports conservative values and fiscal responsibility. He opposes expanding county-funded legal defense for undocumented immigrants in deportation cases. His campaign calls for reducing county spending and applying business management skills to the county budget. Lee has said he would serve as a full-time commissioner and emphasized checks and balances on the county board.
